svg.title: tethered: runtime network egress control for Python
svg.desc: A pixel-art meadow in a wooden frame. On a path down the right, the duck stands with its wrench raised; below it, a shut gate stands across the path, an amber warning sign on its post. The duck thinks of the tethered mark, the line "Runtime network egress control for Python", and "No infrastructure changes", "One function call" and "Zero dependencies", by shcherbak_ai.
